title: Add A2A idempotency metadata to tasks
summary: Add sender-supplied idempotency metadata (key + policy) to A2A tasks so receivers can safely dedupe retries and operators can inspect duplicate risk.
expectedFailureModes: Automatic retry is implemented without a stable dedupe key, causing duplicate external side effects.
Receivers cannot tell whether a redelivery is safe to no-op or must be processed again.
Docs describe retry safety without specifying receiver-side dedupe requirements.
nextAction: Integrate on main, then continue with the next autonomous backlog item.
